card.name: Daily after times in dosing
card.fires_on: The word "daily" (or "day") right after a frequency like "3 times", "four times" or "twice" in dosing instructions. It then expects a treatment length to follow.

modes.label: Times daily
modes.description: "daily" completes a dose frequency such as three times or twice.
modes.example: In the treatment of beriberi, 10 to 20 mg of thiamine hydrochloride are given IM three times<< daily>> for as long as two weeks.

modes.label: Times a day
modes.example: Instill one drop of CYSTADROPS in each eye, 4 times a<< day>> during waking hours.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about how long treatment lasts, such as course, consecutive, and therapy.
card.plain: It fires on "daily" at the end of how often a dose is taken, just before the length of treatment is given.
